verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted URL-to-markdown and search API that is configured through request headers such as engine choice, wait-for-selector, JSON-schema extraction and proxy routing. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to write, upload or deploy custom scraping scripts that run on Jina's platform. The only deployment option documented is self-hosting the open-source Docker image, which is the opposite of avoiding your own infrastructure. Hosting custom scripts is a fair question for a scraping service, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.
